## `pygeovision.labeling.landcover`

ESA WorldCover and 10 m land-cover auto-labelers.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `remap_array` | function | Apply ``mapping`` to every value *at once* (so {10: 20, 20: 30} does not chain 10 -> 30). |
| `mosaic_window` | function | Mosaic the part of ``hrefs`` that lies in ``bbox`` (lon/lat) into one ``uint8`` GeoTIFF. |
| `align_to_reference` | function | Resample a label raster onto ``reference_raster``'s exact grid and CRS (nearest-neighbour). |
| `ESAWorldCoverLabeler` | class | Land-cover labels from ESA WorldCover 2020 (v100) or 2021 (v200). |
| `DynamicWorldLabeler` | class | 10 m, 9-class land-cover labels from one of two backends. **Read which one you get.** |

## `pygeovision.labeling.sam_auto`

SAM Auto-Labeler (E2) — Segment Anything Model for automated label generation. Generates segmentation masks without any manual annotation. Fully native — uses HuggingFace transformers directly.

|---|---|---|
